STUDY 034
Warm Glow & Hands at the Chin
Rights check
Source: 24546.jpg
Warm, intimate, sultry
WORKING NOTES
- The hand position and warm light create the intimate tone.
- Add 'soft focus' for a dreamy effect.
Try this: Add soft focus for a dreamy effect.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair
in a loose low bun and soft face-framing
strands rests her chin on her folded
hands. She wears a white oversized top
with billowing sleeves and a brown strap
at the shoulder. Her gaze is direct, with
a subtle, sultry expression. Warm amber
light falls across her face against a soft,
blurred background. Palette of amber,
cream, and deep brown. Intimate and
warm, in the style of a beauty campaign.
